Trading updates are first-class in the index summary but outside the annual/interim assignment rule; the only TU is the 26 Mar 2026 pre-close, now stale versus FY26 results and the 30 Jul AGM statement.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force annual + interim + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for London Overground, Mistral disposal/completion, the £100m buyback launch, Sizewell C, the March pre-close TU, or the July AGM statement. No task type exists to reconcile filing / TTM / company-adjusted FCF or lease vs adjusted net debt. Naive first/last-of-period selection would assign CH accounts, an IR FY25 deck tagged interim, or an Acquisition tagged annual. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update|corporate_action, so directors must smuggle the FY26 results body in as “annual” despite the catalog tag.

The screen still emits strong_buy (15/22, 5/5 families including dividend and FCF Yield) while fcf_basis_overlay is true but fcf_definition_divergence and fcf_divergence_flagged stay false on a £362.6m / £302.8m / £73.8m split. A 12-week persistent strong_buy with rail nationalisation, an Overground award not yet earning, an in-flight £100m buyback, and no post-FY26 trading update has no watch schema (next TU / H1 2027, DfT franchise handback dates, Overground start, buyback completion, bus-franchising decisions). conviction_score=0.63 and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend declining franchise rail with new contracted/open-access work and will not force BUS vs RAIL vs OPEN ACCESS, franchise vs contracted margin, or FCF-definition / lease-adjusted leverage sections.
